sloka: ततः सहस्ताभरणान् प्रगृह्य विपुलान् भुजान् ।अब्रुवंस्त्रिदशश्रैष्ठाः प्राञ्जलिं राघवं स्थितम् ।। ६.१२०.५ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sahastābharaṇān pragṛhya vipulān bhujān ।abruvaṁstridaśaśraiṣṭhāḥ prāñjaliṁ rāghavaṁ sthitam ।। 6.120.5 ।।

translations.english: Then foremost of gods adorned with ornaments in hands lifted up their long shoulders and greeted Raghava with joined palms and spoke as follows.
